caption: The drawing depicts a built-in wooden cabinet featuring a combination of open shelving and paneled doors. The upper section consists of two tall glass-paned doors with rectangular and arched muntins, divided vertically and with one door fully open to the left, exposing three internal shelves. Above the doors is a large arched molding that matches the shape of the glass panels, and the molding extends upward to a decorative cornice with detailed trim. The lower section of the cabinet has two solid rectangular doors, side by side, with recessed panels and simple hardware including visible metal hinges, a lock, and a keyhole. The overall color palette is a range of soft beige and gray tones, giving the appearance of lightly stained or painted wood. The cabinet is drawn in a corner perspective, and the right side, as well as the backs of the interior shelves, are visible. There are no objects or decorations inside the cabinet; it is empty. The background is a plain, light-colored surface with no additional features.
title: Corner Cupboard (Used for Storing China)
